name: aitp
description: Physics research around a research.md backbone: aitp-memory runs one research cycle; research, verify, writing, learning, brainstorming and distill grow the root, topic and branch notes.

interface.shortDescription: Grow research from a connected research.md backbone across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Begin research work and substantive physics discussions with aitp-memory. Its research cycle recovers the relevant research.md (or the root note when there is no topic), reads what the task needs, states what it should settle, uses the needed skills, checks new, changed or disputed consequential claims while reusing applicable checks, keeps outcomes in their primary homes and reachable, and closes by saying what is supported, where it was saved and what it warrants next. Select guidance for an unmet task need and reconsider it when new evidence changes that need; links are not automatic calls. At natural pauses, apply memory's write decision to results and demonstrated reusable methods. The root note holds directions, cross-topic connections, seeds of new ideas, the agreed agenda and standing agreements; topic and branch notes hold their arguments, with evidence linked. Each main note opens with its question, scope, current answer and decisive gap in about one screen, keeps each live thread's continuation in one dated Current work entry owned by one note, and develops the scientific account below; a read-only reviewer gives the independent preservation read that substantial restructuring requires, and targeted checks of ordinary edits when a failure is plausible. aitp-research investigates, synthesizes sources, designs and runs calculations, develops and debugs code and keeps benchmark suites; aitp-verify checks claims, numbers, references and other models' reviews; aitp-writing writes notes and requested JHEP PDFs; aitp-human-learning and aitp-human-brainstorming handle study and the researcher's choices; aitp-distill keeps reusable methods. Routine work and organization proceed without repeated permission; new investigations, expensive campaigns, installations, submissions and publication are proposed first unless already covered by the request or an existing agreement. Surface unresolved consequential algorithm choices before dependent edits or runs, with alternatives and a recommendation; wait for the researcher unless already settled or explicitly delegated. This is an AITP default, not a required workspace agreement. Keep general rules in the Skills and only local context, preferences and actual exceptions in workspace records. One optional SessionStart reminder points to these rules; no per-turn hooks, ledger or background service.
defaultPrompt: Use aitp-memory and its research cycle for this research topic or discussion.
Tell me where this topic stands and which of its threads are live.
Integrate this result into the topic's argument and close with what it warrants next.
Check this derivation, number or reference with aitp-verify before we rely on it.
Distill this demonstrated method into a focused Skill.
